lapUsage.policy: Lap does not bundle, redistribute, or auto-download any lens calibration data (lap-d52). Lens profiles are locally acquired resources: a user imports a locally licensed lensfun XML file into the content-addressed resource store, where its SHA-256 becomes the versioned profile identity. Every recipe that uses a correction persists explicit provenance (maker, model, user-declared version label, sha256) in recipe.lensProfile plus the content-addressed resource entry, so each distributed-or-acquired profile is auditable per recipe. Renders and exports verify the referenced profile object is present and unchanged before any pixel work and fail explicitly otherwise.
openQuestions: Confirm the license terms of any locally acquired profile before it may be bundled or redistributed; local import does not imply redistribution rights.

license.note: The lensfun_db directory contains no license file. A bundled LGPL-3.0.txt exists under src-tauri/resources/licenses/, but its mapping to this database snapshot is not verified locally. Lensfun upstream licensing (code vs. data terms) has not been checked from primary sources in this inventory.

openQuestions: Confirm lensfun database licensing/attribution for the bundled snapshot (timestamp 1577948414).
